description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first framework that fuses Express simplicity, Fastify performance, and AI‑driven edge routing for Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 AI‑edge boom by advertising built‑in LLM‑driven routing and automatic observability, while promoting the single‑file, zero‑dependency install that works across Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers—giving devs the fastest path from prototype to production without lock‑in.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its AI‑augmented router that auto‑optimizes request paths at the edge, cutting latency by up to 40% versus classic Express setups.
Performance‑first: native HTTP/3, QUIC, and zero‑dependency core deliver Fastify‑level throughput with a fraction of the memory footprint.

Developer experience: TypeScript‑first APIs, instant ESM compatibility across Node/Bun/Deno, and built‑in telemetry/observability mean you spend less time wiring tools and more time building features.
